correctness.rationale: Every factorization lies in the second-column-zero or second-row-zero family; inclusion–exclusion gives the exact identity \(\tau_2(T,E_{11})=2S(T)-C(T)\). The uniform primitive-vector fiber estimate \(U_T(w)=2T/h(w)+O(1)\) follows from two intervals whose centers differ by \(1/|uv|\), with coordinate-zero cases separately covered. The exact shell multiplicity \(8\varphi(h)\) and the convergent Möbius harmonic convolution give the leading coefficient \(384/\pi^2\) and \(O(T^2)\) error. Direct independent enumeration at heights \(1,\ldots,6\) and shell counts through \(40\) agree with the exact identity; the proof, not the finite check, establishes the asymptotic.

value.rationale: The primitive nonzero rank-one target is a natural missing rank boundary in the matrix-divisor asymptotics. Its sharp \(T^2\log T\) growth, including coefficient \(384/\pi^2\) and error \(O(T^2)\), distinguishes it from the quadratic nonsingular and quartic zero-target regimes and improves a rank-one lower bound into a precise counting theorem.
